retailers.return_summary: 30 calendar days from receipt for return or exchange; final sale after that. One return per order; second purchases inside 30 days are final sale. Diamond upgrades are not returnable. Jewellery that is worked on, resized or repaired by another jeweller is not eligible for returns. retailers.name: Anna Sheffield
retailers.store_metadata: Store feed lists city New York, New York, US; ships worldwide.
retailers.return_summary: Returns accepted up to two weeks after delivery for engagement rings, bands and fine jewellery, unworn and in original packaging. retailers.checkout_note: Two-week window and a 10% restocking fee: inspect fast. A resize by anyone else, or an engraving, removes your right to return.
